summary: The instrument index shows systematic weaknesses in line tag assignment, service description confidence, and review flagging. Many tags lack line tag assignments and have low service field confidence, especially for passive and controller types. Several tags have ambiguous or generic services, and some tag types (e.g., SPARE, SHORE) are not standard or need justification. Review flags are present but not always justified by field confidence. High-impact issues are listed below.

comments.issue: Missing line tag assignment.
comments.reason: Line tag is essential for traceability and process mapping.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or line list showing correct line tag.
